name: SugarAI
description: SugarAI is an AI-driven CRM platform that helps you manage your sales, marketing, and customer support better

events.d: Runs when a new record is created in a selected module such as Leads, Contacts, or Tasks.
Creates a new record in any module you specify (Leads, Contacts, Tasks, etc.).
Runs when an existing record is updated in a specified module such as Leads, Contacts, or Tasks.
Updates an existing record in any module you specify (Leads, Contacts, Tasks, etc.).

events.n: Find or Create Record In Any Module
events.d: Finds a record in selected module or creates a new one if none exists.
Create a new lead in SugarCRM.
Update a lead using an ID, email address, or phone number.
Delete a lead by ID, email, or phone.
Fetch all leads or search leads by name, email, or phone.
Find an account by ID, name, email, or phone and update its fields (for example: name, phone, address, owner).
Delete an account using ID, name, email, or phone number.
Retrieve account records by ID, name, email, or phone, or fetch all accounts. Return simplified, custom, or full fields.
